title: Canonical localization identifications for normalized derived comparisons
statement:
Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal A',\mathcal B,\mathcal B'$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], with chosen derived categories and localization functors $Q_{\mathcal C}:\operatorname{CoCh}(\mathcal C)\to D(\mathcal C)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ and $G:\mathcal A'\to\mathcal B'$ be additive functors [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. Assume every integer-indexed cochain complex over $\mathcal A$ and over $\mathcal A'$ admits a quasi-isomorphism to a K-injective complex (a complex receiving only null-homotopic maps from acyclic complexes), and write $RF,RG$ for their total right derived functors [def-sfb-right-derived-functor]. Let $r:\mathcal A'\to\mathcal A$ and $s:\mathcal B'\to\mathcal B$ be exact additive functors, meaning additive and preserving finite limits and finite colimits. Write $r_D,s_D$ for their termwise induced functors on derived categories and $\lambda_{t,N}:t_D(QN)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q(tN)$ for their canonical localization identifications [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. Suppose $e:Fr=sG$ is an equality of functors on objects and morphisms, and $\beta:RF\,r_D\xrightarrow{\sim}s_D\,RG$ is a natural isomorphism. All appearances of $F,G,r,s$ on complexes mean degreewise application. Define the following canonical isomorphisms, for arbitrary complexes $N,J$ over $\mathcal A'$:
$$\operatorname{comparisonComplexIso}_{N}:RF(Q_{\mathcal A}(rN))\xrightarrow{\sim}s_D(RG(Q_{\mathcal A'}N)),\qquad \operatorname{comparisonComplexIso}_{N}=\beta_{Q_{\mathcal A'}N}\circ RF(\lambda_{r,N}^{-1}),$$
and
$$\operatorname{comparisonTargetIso}_{J}:Q_{\mathcal B}(F(rJ))\xrightarrow{\sim}s_D(Q_{\mathcal B'}(GJ)),\qquad \operatorname{comparisonTargetIso}_{J}=\lambda_{s,GJ}^{-1}\circ Q_{\mathcal B}(\operatorname{eqToIso}(e)_J).$$
Here $\operatorname{eqToIso}(e)_J$ is the component on complexes of the degreewise natural isomorphism induced by $e$. Neither definition assumes that $N$ or $J$ is K-injective or that $r$ preserves K-injective complexes.

lean.statement:
noncomputable def normalizedDerivedComparisonComplexIso (N : CochainComplex A' ℤ) :
    (F.rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutions enoughA).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((r.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj N)) ≅
      s.mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((G.rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutions enoughA').obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N))

They are plain definitions, not choices from the common-resolution theorem. Section parameters have independent object, morphism and localization universes. No source file is changed and no duplicate is defined.
